jobs.description:
**European Patent Examiner in Medical Device Engineering (22631\)**

  

**Duration of contract:** Five years, renewable (full\-time)
  

**Location:** Germany (Munich/Berlin) or the Netherlands (The Hague)
  

**Application deadline:** 2 November 2026

  

  

**At the European Patent Office (EPO), we explore breakthrough technologies before they reach the public.** As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future.  

We are an inclusive, purpose\-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO.  

**Your role and impact**
As a Patent Examiner, you will:
* **examine patent applications** – including technical documentation and drawings – in one of our official languages (English, French or German)
* **analyse new inventions** to evaluate their novelty and inventive step
* **conduct in\-depth research** using digital search tools, scientific databases and patent information sources to identify the most relevant prior art
* **apply legal and procedural frameworks** to make clear, high\-quality decisions on whether a patent should be granted
* **communicate your findings** clearly and constructively with applicants and other parties
* **collaborate with international colleagues** in a diverse and inclusive environment
* **maintain high\-quality standards** with strong attention to detail and scientific rigour
* **contribute to Europe's innovation ecosystem** by ensuring fair and consistent application of the European Patent Convention (EPC) and related legal texts
  

**Your profile**
**We're looking for expertise in at least one of these fields:**
Engineers and scientists with experience in the design, development, testing or manufacture of medical devices and surgical technologies, such as:
* Minimally invasive devices: catheters, guidewires, delivery systems
* Drug delivery: microneedles, injectors and related devices
* Surgical devices: surgical instruments, powered and robotic surgical systems
* Spinal implants: pedicle screws, rods, intervertebral cages, disc prostheses
  

**You will thrive with us if you**
* have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience
* enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles
* are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law
* are analytical, detail\-oriented and open\-minded
* are confident using digital technologies and AI\-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking
* value both independent work and team collaboration
* are comfortable making structured, evidence\-based decisions
  

No prior IP(intellectual property) experience? No problem.
We provide full legal and procedural training to get you started.  

  

**Our minimum requirements for this post**
* diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above
* excellent knowledge (at least C1\) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1\) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required)
* work experience in industry would be an advantage
* citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation
  

**What we offer**
* competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience)
* 30\+ days of annual leave \+ flexible working arrangements
* generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states)
* family\-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support
* pension and insurance: excellent social security coverage
* examiner training: a comprehensive two\-year development programme covering all aspects of patent search and examination, starting with a six\-week Academy programme on\-site and delivered in English
* inclusive culture: 35\+ nationalities, supportive networks and a strong DEI commitment
* facilities: on\-site gym, health services, staff clubs and more (depending on location)
* top locations: high quality of life and a thriving international community
* (see full list of benefits)
  

**What to expect next**
We are recruiting for positions starting from 2027 and are already building a talent pool for upcoming roles in 2028\. If selected to join our talent pool, you'll get:  

* priority access to future vacancies
* exclusive access to learning offers and resources to enhance your IP awareness and your readiness to become a patent examiner
* regular updates and insights
  

Being a member of the talent pool gives you a chance to join our journey from the very beginning and to be fully prepared for when the next positions go live.
**Process**  

The successful candidate will be selected on the basis of qualifications, competencies, professional experience and language knowledge, supplemented as appropriate by technical assessments, interviews and/or a personality questionnaire.

  

A talent pool (reserve list) will be constituted should more candidates than required at this time be considered suitable following the selection procedure. Such talent pools are valid for a period of 24 months and talent pool candidates may be contacted should a vacancy with substantially the same profile arise during that period.

  

In line with the EPO's values and the standards of honesty and integrity expected of its employees, candidates are expected to uphold these same principles throughout the selection process.

  

We recognise that AI tools may be used to support the preparation of job applications. Candidates nevertheless remain responsible for the content of their application and for the accuracy of the information submitted – and we encourage candidates to ensure that their job application remains an authentic reflection of their own qualifications, skills and experience.

  

During interviews and assessments, candidates are expected to rely on their own knowledge, experience and judgement, without the use of AI tools or other forms of real\-time assistance, unless explicitly stated otherwise.

  

  

**Ready to apply?**Click **Apply** and take the first step towards a meaningful role in which science, innovation and purpose come together.  

For tips on how to prepare your application, and to read more about our recruitment process, visit our Careers page.

**Job group:** 4


**Grade:** G7 to G10 (net (basic) monthly salary\* for this vacancy: EUR 7 076 to 10 164, depending on experience and location)


**Career path:** Technical


**Working mode:** Hybrid \*\*


**Pre\-selection outcome communicated by**: end December 2026


**Technical Interviews estimated for:** October 2026 – January 2027


**Final interviews planned for:** November 2026 – February 2027

*\*\*The position will require relocation to the country of one of the following EPO sites: Germany (Munich/Berlin) or The Netherlands (The Hague). The final location will be discussed later and depends also on team\-specific needs.*  

We welcome all applications for vacant positions. We consider each on its professional merits – regardless of your nationality, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, parental responsibilities, age, religion or belief.

✓ See the latest inventions and enable innovation
  

✓ Work with inspiring people from a variety of cultures

**What's in it for you?**
  

✓ A competitive salary
  

✓ Family\-friendly benefits
  

✓ A good work\-life balance
  

✓ Generous flexibility options
  

✓ Relocation benefits and various allowances
  

✓ Contributory medical insurance and pension schemes
  

✓ 30 days' leave per year

We are the patent office for Europe. We are proud to deliver high\-quality patents and efficient services that foster innovation, competitiveness and economic growth.

We will empower and motivate our staff to set worldwide standards in intellectual property. Our Office will be effective and transparent, respond to the needs of our users and be agile in managing the changing demands and conditions of a dynamic global patent system. Our work will contribute to a safer, smarter and more sustainable world.


**Our values**
  

All our relationships within our Office and with partners around the world will prosper through trust, fairness, mutual respect, adaptability, collaboration and a commitment to excellence.

We believe that diversity is fundamental to our success. Our inclusive work environment respects, values and celebrates our individual differences. We want you to be yourself at work.Join us on this exciting journey to a more digital, collaborative and sustainable organisation.

jobs.title: Software & Hardware Developer (C# / .NET / IoT)
jobs.description:
**WE KNOW THIS IS A LONG JOB AD, SO HERE'S THE TL;DR:**

We're looking for a practical technical generalist who likes building things.

A lot of the job is C\#/.NET, SQL, internal systems, dashboards and integrations, but those systems connect to real machinery, scanners, printers, sensors, GPS trackers, Android handhelds and hardware we build ourselves.

You do not need to already be a professional developer. If you work in IT support, infrastructure, sysadmin or another technical role and already code, script, automate or build electronics projects in your own time, we want to hear from you.

You'll get broad exposure, direct access to the technical lead, plenty of autonomy as you develop, and the chance to work on everything from agentic AI development to ESP32s, computer vision, 3D printing and industrial integrations.

*£29,000 to £34,000 DOE \| Ramsgate \| Primarily on\-site*

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a practical, curious and technically minded person to join our small in\-house technical team.

EPCC is a garment printing, fulfilment and e\-commerce business, and a large part of our operation is powered by systems we design and build ourselves.

A lot of the day\-to\-day work is software development, writing software to run our internal CRM, dashboards, online ordering systems, production tools, artwork proofing, warehouse systems and integrations.

But these are rarely isolated, spreadsheet\-style CRUD applications.

Our software connects directly to the physical operation of the business: production machinery, barcode scanners, printers, Android handhelds, shipping carriers, sensors and devices we have built ourselves.

One day you might be building a C\# feature or investigating a SQL problem. The next you could be wiring an ESP32, soldering a sensor, 3D\-printing an enclosure or testing a prototype on the warehouse floor.

**WHO YOU ARE**

We are deliberately open to people from technical backgrounds such as:

* IT support
* Systems administration
* Infrastructure
* Networking
* Electronics
* Technical support
* Junior software development

If you write scripts, automate tasks, build applications, run a homelab, work with Arduino or ESP32 boards, create electronics projects, or generally spend your own time making technology do useful things, we want to hear about it.

**Personal projects count.**

If you work in IT support but have GitHub projects, an ESP32, a soldering iron and half\-finished technical experiments at home, you could be exactly who we are looking for.

**WHAT A REAL PROJECT LOOKS LIKE**

One recent project started with our goods\-out system and developed into an end\-to\-end parcel tracking platform.

It involved:

* Integrating physical GPS trackers into our warehouse dispatch workflow
* Connecting tracker information with shipping\-carrier APIs
* Automatically generating and printing return labels and instructions
* Building a customer\-facing web interface where clients can monitor consignments in real time on a map
* Developing background services to monitor shipments and identify exceptions
* Creating workflows that allow us to intervene proactively when something does not look right

The engineering does not stop at "does it work?"

Displaying large numbers of live parcel locations also means thinking about the commercial cost of map tiles, API calls, polling frequency and third\-party services.

We build with real business constraints in mind: cost, reliability, scalability, API limits, maintainability, performance and operational impact.

*A technically clever solution that costs too much to operate is not a good solution.*

**FROM SENSOR TO DASHBOARD**

Other projects cross the boundary between software and hardware in a different way.

You might build or integrate a sensor for a piece of equipment, then build the software that:

* Collects and stores its readings
* Graphs the data over time
* Allows users to configure warning and alert thresholds
* Generates notifications when readings fall outside normal limits
* Helps the production team understand what is happening

Because we build much of this ourselves, there is scope to work on the entire solution rather than one isolated component.

You may literally build the sensor at one end of the project and the dashboard displaying its data at the other.

**OTHER PROJECTS**

Recent and ongoing work includes:

* **Computer Vision:** Using machine learning to help detect garment\-printing defects during production
* **Dimensioning:** ToF sensors for measuring parcels and dimensions
* **Machinery Monitoring:** Proximity and Hall\-effect sensors for monitoring equipment
* **Fluid Tracking:** Ultrasonic sensors for monitoring liquid levels
* **Pneumatics:** Pressure transducers for monitoring compressors and pneumatic systems
* **Microcontrollers:** ESP32\-based devices and low\-power embedded systems
* **Remote Nodes:** Solar and battery\-powered outdoor hardware
* **Displays:** E\-ink integrations
* **Mobile \& Scanning:** Android handhelds with integrated barcode scanners and thermal printers
* **Custom Hardware:** Devices designed around specific production problems
* **Prototyping:** 3D\-printed enclosures, brackets and prototype parts
* **Assembly:** Soldering and basic electronics assembly

We have our own 3D printer and soldering equipment, so ideas can go from software prototype to physical device in\-house.

You do not need previous commercial embedded, IoT or machine\-learning experience.

You do need to be someone who looks at a sensor, microcontroller, camera system or interesting piece of hardware and wonders what you could make it do.

**OUR SOFTWARE STACK**

Our main stack includes:

* C\# and .NET
* ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core
* Razor Pages
* Existing ASP.NET Web Forms applications
* SQL Server
* Entity Framework
* HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Windows desktop applications
* REST APIs and third\-party integrations
* Git

You may also work with Android devices, barcode scanners, thermal printers, industrial equipment and other production hardware that integrates with our internal systems.

You do not need to arrive knowing all of this.

We can mentor someone with good technical aptitude and a solid programming foundation.

**AI\-FIRST DEVELOPMENT**

We take an AI\-first, agentic approach to development, using coding agents as a normal part of our workflow rather than treating AI as simple autocomplete.

We use AI to accelerate implementation, investigate unfamiliar code, prototype ideas, debug problems, refactor systems and work through multi\-step development tasks.

Developers are still expected to understand the systems, review the output, recognise when the AI is wrong and take responsibility for the finished result.

*AI makes us faster. It does not remove the requirement to understand what we are building.*

**AUTONOMY**

We are a small team, and there is a lot of scope for autonomy once you understand the systems and the business.

The technical lead sets the overall architecture and standards, but we are more interested in giving you a problem to solve than prescribing every class, screen and implementation detail.

As your experience grows, we expect you to:

* Investigate problems independently
* Suggest better approaches
* Make sensible technical trade\-offs
* Think about cost and business impact
* Understand how the software affects the wider operation
* Increasingly own solutions from idea through to production

You will work directly with the technical lead rather than through several layers of project management.

**IT ISN'T ONLY DEVELOPMENT**

Because we are a small technical team, there are no rigid boundaries between software development, support and infrastructure.

The role also includes some:

* General Windows PC and user support
* Printer and scanner troubleshooting
* Application support
* Deployment
* Basic infrastructure work
* DevOps\-style tasks
* Investigation when something we have built stops working

We have external MSP support where appropriate, but most normal day\-to\-day technical issues are handled internally.

If a PC stops working, a label printer misbehaves, an application has a problem or a device you built stops responding, you may be involved in resolving it.

**There is no routine out\-of\-hours or on\-call requirement.**

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We care more about technical aptitude, curiosity and problem solving than whether you tick every technology box.

You should have:

* Some practical programming or scripting experience
* A methodical approach to troubleshooting
* An interest in how systems work
* The ability to learn unfamiliar technologies
* An interest in hardware, electronics or physical systems
* A willingness to get hands\-on rather than treating support or hardware as somebody else's problem

Useful experience includes:

* C\# or another object\-oriented language
* .NET
* SQL
* Git
* Python or PowerShell
* JavaScript
* REST APIs
* Windows administration
* Networking
* General IT support
* ESP32, Arduino or Raspberry Pi
* Electronics and soldering
* 3D printing or CAD
* Home automation
* IoT projects
* Computer vision or machine learning

*None of these individually is mandatory.*

**LOCATION AND ELIGIBILITY**

This is a primarily on\-site role in Ramsgate, Kent, with occasional work at our Margate site.

Applicants must be able to commute reliably to our Ramsgate site, or be relocating before starting the role.

Own transport is beneficial due to occasional travel between sites.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK for this role.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply by email to itjobs@epcc.co.uk.

If you have GitHub repositories, personal projects, electronics builds, scripts, automations or anything else interesting you have made, include those too.

*The cooler and more obscure, the better.*

**RECRUITMENT AGENCIES**

Due to the nature of this role, we are handling recruitment directly and are not inviting applications from recruitment agencies at this time.

**We welcome direct applications from candidates.**

Please do not submit speculative CVs or candidate details without a prior written agreement with EPCC.

Where details are submitted without such an agreement, no recruitment fee will be payable and we reserve the right to contact the candidate directly.

Pay: £29,000\.00\-£34,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* On\-site parking

Work Location: In person

Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.
Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.

Project description

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. - Proactive thinking, excellent problem-solving, and analytical skills

We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.

Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Engineering - Our engineering team is at the core of our products and connected directly to the mission of preventing cyberattacks. We are constantly innovating — challenging the way we, and the industry, think about cybersecurity. Our engineers don’t shy away from building products to solve problems no one has pursued before. We define the industry instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, excited by the prospect of a challenge, and empowered by the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are only enabled by a secure digital environment.

The Product

Secrets Hub is a cloud-native, multi-cloud SaaS product that helps organizations centralize secrets management across AWS, Azure, GCP, and HashiCorp Vault, securing critical workloads for the world's largest enterprises.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will design and implement scalable, secure services for the Secrets Hub platform while leading complex technical initiatives and architectural decisions. You will set the standard for software quality and security, collaborating globally to drive modern, IaC-driven development and long-term system reliability.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement scalable and secure services as part of the Secrets Hub platform.
Lead complex technical initiatives, architectural decisions, and system design within the team.
Set the standard for software quality, security, testing, and CI/CD practices.
Collaborate daily with product managers, architects, and engineers across global teams.
Work with AWS serverless technologies and AWS CDK in a modern, IaC-driven development lifecycle.
Troubleshoot complex production scenarios and drive long-term improvements in reliability and observability.
Be a key contributor to defining the technical identity of a growing team.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 7 years of experience in software engineering, focusing on distributed systems and backend development.
Extensive hands-on experience with AWS serverless technologies and AWS CDK.
Proven expertise in modern software development lifecycles, including IaC and CI/CD practices.
Ability to proactively drive discussions with stakeholders and lead architectural decisions for complex technical initiatives architectural decisions and system design for complex technical initiatives.
Strong background in implementing software quality, security, and testing standards.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working within cybersecurity or secrets management domains.
Proven track record of driving long-term improvements in system reliability and observability.
Experience collaborating effectively with global, cross-functional teams.
Strong ability to mentor team members and shape the technical identity of an engineering group.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
